result.reason: The redline adds the preferred USD 5M cyber/privacy coverage and retains acceptable fallback E&O coverage of USD 1M, statutory workers’ compensation, and certificates on request. However, general liability remains only USD 1M without the required USD 2M aggregate, so the clause does not reach even the fallback position. The cyber trigger is also broader than necessary because it applies to any Confidential Information rather than only Customer Data processing. The margin comment does not cure these operative-language issues.
